name: growth-division
title: Growth & division (mitosis)
question:
Can the wrapper drive volume growth and mitotic division through CompuCell3D so that a
small seed population expands into a large one, read back through the output ports?
hypothesis:
Cells whose target volume increases each Monte-Carlo step grow, and once they reach a
division threshold they split via the CPM mitosis steppable — so the population grows
roughly geometrically while mean cell volume stays near the post-division target.
objective:
Seed 25 cells on a 150x150 lattice, advance 3000 Monte-Carlo steps through
`CompuCell3DProcess` with growth + mitosis enabled, and track population and mean
volume through the output ports.
description:
A growth-and-division demonstration: each cell's target volume ramps upward; when a
cell exceeds the division volume the wrapper's mitosis steppable splits it into two
daughters. The run is a single real cc3d 4.6.0 trajectory — genuine CPM growth and
division, not a reimplementation.
claim:
The wrapper drives real CPM growth and mitosis: the population expands from 25 to 800
cells over 3000 MCS (15 -> 480 type-A, 10 -> 320 type-B) while mean cell volume rises
modestly from 24.8 to 28.1 px, consistent with divide-at-threshold dynamics.
expected_behavior: Population grows substantially (geometric expansion by mitosis).
Mean cell volume stays bounded near the division target (does not blow up).
Both cell types proliferate in proportion.

readouts.name: Mean cell volume
readouts.description: Rises 24.8 -> 28.1 px; bounded near the post-division target.

behavior_tests.name: Growth to target volume and mitotic division on the real engine
behavior_tests.description:
The growth + mitosis composite runs on cc3d 4.6.0 through the single-Process wrapper
and expands the population ~32x by division while holding mean volume bounded
(committed animated scene + population/volume charts).

limitations: Division cadence and target volumes are the wrapper's demonstration defaults, not calibrated to a specific cell line.

blocked_by: Growth to target volume and mitotic division on the real engine
